newsitem.title: USA: Class action brought against Arthur Andersen.
newsitem.headline: Class action brought against Arthur Andersen.

text.p: A law firm representing purchasers of Discovery Zone Inc securities said on Tuesday that the buyers had filed a class action lawsuit against Arthur Andersen LLP, alleging the accounting firm violated accounting principles.

The purchasers, who bought Discovery Zone securities in 1994 and 1995, said their suit relates to the accounting firm's unqualified or "clean" audit of Discovery Zone's 1993 and 1994 year-end finanacial statements.

No one was immediately available at the law firm, Abbey, Gardy & Squitieri LLP, to comment on possible damages being sought by the shareholders, nor was anyone immediately available at Arthur Andersen to comment on the case.
